name: Klassen: Juletyven
description: Sofia and Emil have agreed to give each other presents for Christmas. When the present for Sofia turns out to be expensive, Emil asks his friend Liam for help earning some money.

videos.title: Prologue
videos.overview: What will the kids be doing during the Christmas holidays?

videos.title: Part 1
videos.overview: Christmas is close and Sofia and Emil have agreed to give each other presents. Sofias presents is quite expensive, so Emil asks Liam for help earning some money. Sofia has spent all her money on the present for Emil when she spots the shirt that she would really like to have.

videos.title: Part 2
videos.overview: Emma has been arrested, Sofia hopes that they will just let her go. Meanwhile Emil is down because of his lack of money for Sofia's present, and he's not completely satisfied with Liam's suggestion to just give her candy. Liam and Emil find a lost wallet, but is it okay to just take the money?

videos.title: Part 3
videos.overview: Emil and Liam set out to find the owner of the wallet they found, meanwhile Emma is getting in more trouble than Sofia thought she would. Will the boys get a finders fee so Emil can buy the shirt for Sofia?

videos.title: Part 4
videos.overview: Sofia turns up at Emil's door after having run away. She tells him all that has happened, and he offers to help her get it all sorted out.
